decision: Retain native W8 activation measurement as an independent route and transfer-validation instrument; current priority is bounded Hauhau weight-difference recovery.
verified_from_installed_source: Both Gemma4 language and multimodal wrapper advertise SupportsEagle3; set_aux_hidden_state_layers unwraps to the EagleModelMixin decoder.
Normal Gemma4 forward exposes index 0 before decoder layers, and index i+1 after decoder layer i including its per-layer contribution and scalar.
Auxiliary index 30 is captured before the final model RMSNorm. Do not equate it with a normalized final Hugging Face hidden state without matching hook semantics.
kv_sharing_fast_prefill uses a separate forward path that returns normalized states without the normal auxiliary collection. Disable that optimization in a capture profile.
extract_hidden_states uses a cache-only dummy model, not another learned draft checkpoint. It requires num_speculative_tokens=1 and a nonempty eagle_aux_hidden_state_layer_ids list.
ExampleHiddenStatesConnector saves token_ids plus hidden_states. TP rank 0 writes; the local implementation counts one completion and uses async disk writes with a companion lock.
The connector normally exports only prompt tokens. include_output_tokens is optional and excludes the last sampled token; the initial study should use max_tokens=1 and prompt-only data.
The extractor cache supports auto/BF16, explicitly rejects quantized KV. Retain BF16 KV for this diagnostic.
The GPU Model Runner V2 extractor requires greedy draft selection and reports supports_mm_inputs=False. Start with text-only prompts; this does not establish vision capture support.
Hidden-state buffers are replicated by rank in the inspected proposer. TP does not divide their width or selected-layer count.
No native W8 capture, captured-direction extraction, LoRA-plus-capture compatibility test, or capture-instrumented behavioral equivalence test has run in this phase.

resource_estimates.formula: (max_num_batched_tokens + max_num_seqs) * selected_layer_count * 2816 * 2 bytes for the persistent proposer staging buffer per TP rank
resource_estimates.not_a_peak_estimate: Additional live auxiliary tensors, torch.stack temporary, hidden-state cache pages, cache extraction GPU temporary, pinned CPU copy, KV, model weights and allocator workspace also consume memory. Source-derived buffer arithmetic is not a measured launch fit.
resource_estimates.storage_policy: Process one prompt at a time. Preserve prompt/token/layer identity, vector selection, code/config hashes, per-file checksums and selected vectors. Remove newly created full-token scratch only after selected-vector output validation; avoid caching an entire dataset of all-token activations.

bounded_validation_sequence: After current evaluation completes, or after an explicit recorded cancellation, use a separate immutable capture launch profile. Do not change the current benchmark profile mid-run.

Start baseline only, TP2, eager, prefix caching off, fast prefill off, BF16 KV, text prompts, max sequences 1, max context/batched tokens 256, auxiliary indices [0,15,30]. Use the same native INT8 weights and tokenizer, explicit thinking-template setting, and max_tokens=1.

Validate exact rendered token IDs; exported shape [prompt_length,3,2816]; BF16 finite values; layer-order mapping; completed lock/write handling; and server health after repeated requests. Compare first-token IDs/logprobs with the ordinary baseline for predeclared benign prompts, allowing measured numeric tolerance rather than asserting bitwise determinism.

Only after the smoke is sound, expand selected layers and context one dimension at a time, up to all31 and 1024 for short calibration prompts. Measure actual peak GPU/host memory and post-request block reclamation.
Check native reversible LoRA routing separately before using staged edited-model captures. A passing baseline extraction alone does not establish edited-model equivalence.
Do not use the extraction runtime as the quality/scoring runtime. Restore the ordinary frozen serving profile for matched behavioral evaluations.
Do not run long generated-trace extraction until multi-token feedback and output-token alignment have been validated against this exact installed build.

known_primary_report.status: A user report, not reproduced here
known_primary_report.claim: Reports first-column feedback errors on multi-token generation in extract_hidden_states. Our installed legacy proposer visibly returns sampled_token_ids[:, :1].
known_primary_report.implication: Use prompt-only/max_tokens=1 for the initial capture; do not assume generated traces or instrumented long-answer scores are equivalent.
